summary.text: Steven Jacob is the Libertarian candidate for Kansas's 1st District. He describes himself as a 55-year-old retiree and is running on reducing federal spending and the national debt and ending U.S. involvement in foreign wars. Little other biographical information is publicly available.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Lawrence High School, according to Ballotpedia.
Describes himself as a 55-year-old retiree who says both parties spend without limit. Ballotpedia lists his profession as retired.
